comment: SEIZURE-state companion sweep, RATE-MATCHED variant of sweep_config_seizure.json: same 20 networks, same seeds, PAIRED noise streams. Phenotype: sahp_ainc_slow=0.004 only -- sahp_tau_slow stays at the registry default 6500 ms (the normal state's own value), restoring the pure single-knob manipulation. Chosen 2026-08-30 to put seizure per-neuron rates in the real-2p-data band: validated on c50_seed01, 60 s -> mean 0.94 Hz, p5-p95 0.72-1.27 Hz, 11 bursts/min, participation 0.84 (the tau=3000 config runs ~1.7 Hz / ~24 bursts/min). Scan record: analysis/rate_operating_point_scan.py; probes at tau 7500/8000 pull p95 under 1.1 but drop p5 to ~0.6 and participation to ~0.58 -- not recommended.
